description: Add tasks to a sprint (Laviya folder), or remove them with remove: true, after the user approved it. All tasks must belong to the sprint's project; otherwise nothing is changed. Returns per task added, alreadyPresent, removed or notPresent, so repeating the call is harmless.

folderID.description: Sprint (Laviya folder) id from laviya_list_sprints or laviya_create_sprint.

remove.description: true removes the tasks from the sprint instead of adding them. Default false.

taskIDs.description: Tasks of the sprint's project. If any task is of another project or not accessible, nothing is changed.

name: laviya_assign_tasks_to_sprint
title: Assign Tasks To Sprint
